title: outside keys and an object's outside fields are `tainted`, and only an array converts to an array
scope: Three ways text from outside the program still reached a plain `string` after 0279: a `foreach` key, a shape target filled from an object's fields, and a nullable or union operand converted to an array. Not in scope: a key qualifier written on an array type, and a map nested in a `queryAs`/`postAs`/`jsonAs` target.
dependsOnText: [0279](0279.md) § 1 and § 3 — text out of `mixed` is `tainted`, and a written type says so itself; [0053](0053.md) — what a `foreach` binds; [0007](0007.md) — the conversion table.

summary.headline: Keys and object fields from outside are tainted
summary.body:
A `foreach` key over request data, a decoded document or an array of tainted values is now
`tainted string`, so it cannot reach a query until it is checked. Converting an object to a shape
reads each text field from the object's own field, and a `mixed` or tainted field needs
`tainted {…}`. `?string as array<string>` no longer compiles.
